scope: Only round_002 Astra NEXT: independent analytic visibility plus identified actual raster output on the unchanged mixed lamp orbit/zoom. Engineering diagnostic, not H1 comparison or P1 promotion.

controls.assets: Read sealed round_002 lamp_mesh.npz, mixed.npz and camera_trajectories.json; hash-bind all four stroke snapshots. No regeneration or style edits.
controls.style: mixed (the original videos' style); parallel/cross/edit unchanged but not expanded into new temporal trajectories
controls.render: Same CPU raster algorithm, 512x512, 2x supersampling, 1px width, 0.006 world depth tolerance, fixed light/ink, no LOD
controls.resources: CPU affinity [0,1], all thread caps 2, no GPU, no download, each evaluation invocation <600s; total round <=40min ending 05:01:46 JST

sampling.definition: Per saved stroke, N=ceil(total polyline arc/0.003); fixed midpoint arc samples at (j+0.5)*L/N, each weighted L/N. Consecutive coincident anchors carry zero arc. Stable stroke index and sample index across all cameras.
sampling.reference: Continuous lathe ray/profile intersections at each exact projected sample coordinate; no triangle depth or rendered visibility used for expected visibility. Separately rasterize analytic part labels at 512 for fixed 2px boundary exclusion.
sampling.eligibility: Positive depth, in image, nearest analytic hit belongs to the stored part, absolute optical-z discrepancy <=0.006 world; nearest pixel is >2px from analytic silhouette/part boundary. All exclusion categories and sample/world-length denominators retained.
sampling.caveat: Continuous analytic geometry shares the authored procedural recipe with mesh, not independently acquired reconstruction truth; proxy chord error and known rim outliers retained. Expected visibility depends on fixed proxy path points, not predicted depth.

raster_identity.method: Instrument unchanged renderer to retain each stroke's actual depth-tested supersampled layer. Same maximum-filter width, foreground clip, quantization and LANCZOS downsampling. Local crops aligned to 2px grid with >=8 supersample pixels halo; regression checks exact equality to full-canvas layer. Reconstructed full images must byte-match all 60 original saved frames.
raster_identity.support: Final quantized hatch pixels >0.04 AND own rendered layer >0.04. Count all nonzero per-stroke final layers for overlap; support pixel is identifiable only if exactly one stroke contributes. Sparse provenance and composite/fault hatch images saved.
raster_identity.ambiguity: A sample is overlap-ambiguous if any pixel with >=2 nonzero stroke layers lies within Euclidean 1.5px of its expected projection. Freeze these baseline exclusions for all fault variants. Missing baseline raster output does not exclude a sample.
raster_identity.limitations: Metrics are distances to identifiable raster support, not a subpixel skeleton or along-stroke phase correspondence. Final structure/contour ink is kept separate and cannot substitute for hatch support. Report overlap exclusions explicitly; no claim about excluded regions.

metrics.frame: For every eligible unambiguous sample, nearest identifiable actual pixel of the SAME stroke. Empty support gives infinite distance and missing=true. Report weighted finite-distance mean/P95 and missing fraction separately; never omit missing from denominator.
metrics.pair: 35 consecutive orbit pairs and 23 zoom pairs (no wrap). Same world sample must be independently eligible and baseline-unambiguous in both frames. Report common length / total length / jointly visible length and stroke coverage. Report per-frame support offsets and norm(offset_next-offset_prev) where both detected; report denominator separately.
metrics.events: On all common samples: detected->missing disappearance, missing->detected reappearance, both-missing, both-detected. Rates weighted by world arc. Raw per-sample arrays and per-frame/per-pair/per-part summaries retained.
metrics.statistical_scope: One procedural object and seed, repeated frames not independent objects; descriptive statistics only. No frozen baseline quality pass threshold or 1024px threshold rescaling claim.

faults.drift: On odd frame indices translate the actual final hatch raster and each stroke layer support by (+6,+6) output pixels with zero fill, no wrap; even frames unchanged. Same fixed denominators.
faults.drop: On indices index%3==1 omit stroke IDs whose SHA256 UTF-8 integer modulo 5 equals zero before compositing; others unchanged. Save actually recomposited fault hatch raster. Same fixed denominators.
faults.go: Toy algorithm regressions pass; original 60 full images byte-match; all coverage categories saved; on eligible odd-frame samples drift weighted finite-distance mean exceeds baseline by >1px; on eligible selected drop-frame samples missing fraction is exactly 1 and exceeds baseline by >0.5, with >=100 selected eligible samples; injected drop creates at least one disappearance and reappearance.
faults.no_go: Any gate failure is retained with unchanged thresholds. No tuning on these already exposed trajectories, no difficult-view omission, no H2/H3/LOD/dataset expansion.

freeze: Commit protocol/tests before implementation regression run. Commit implementation and hash lock before first lamp evaluation. RED uses deliberately faulty metric backends on toy arrays; baseline metrics remain unopened until lock.
